text:
Things do what they do. You can make a thing do other things. This book is about that.
Stuff is what a thing is made of.
A cup is a thing you drink from.
Water is a liquid you drink.
A thing is empty when there is nothing in it.
A thing is full when there is no room for more.
To pour is to make a liquid go from one thing into another.
The cup is empty. There is nothing in it.
Pour the water in. Now the cup is full.
Drink some of it. Now the cup is half full and half empty.
Drink it all. Now the cup is empty again.
Put soap in the water. Wash the cup with it.
The soap water goes out into the sink. The cup is empty again.

Day comes, then night, then day again.
It is a thing that shows time with hands or numbers.
It is the time after the day and before the night.
It is the time after the night and before the day.
It means not at any time, not ever.
It is the time when the sun is gone and the sky is dark.
The bright thing in the night sky is the moon.
The clock showed the time as the day went on.
The moon appeared in the evening when the sky turned blue.
The clock kept time, always moving forward.
The day and night followed each other, always the same.
Night fell after evening, and stars appeared above.

This one is longer than that one. Hold them together to see.
Compare means to look at two things to see how they are alike or different.
Bigger means more in size than something else.
The bamboo stick is longer than the stick next to it.
I want to compare the two sticks to see which is bigger.
I compared the sticks and found that this one is longer.
I measured both sticks with the string and saw that one was measured longer than the other.
I measured the sticks again and saw that the longer one was not just longer but also better for building.

First this, then that. It took a long time.
The time that has not yet come.
To begin something for the first time.
A day, from midnight to midnight.
To begin something, to do the first thing.
At any time in the past, future, or now.
To finish something, to end it.
He gave it warm milk and covered it with a soft cloth.
He felt happy, and the day was not yet done.
He knew the future would be better, because he had helped.
I started building a small boat from bamboo early in the day.
I tried it in the water, it floated, so I felt happy.
Carlo dug under a log to find the animal.
He found the cold, tired animal and took it home.
Carlo waited all day for the animal to wake up.
When it did, it moved quickly around the room.

It is here, not there. It is over that way.
The word above means higher than something else in space.
The word backward means moving in the opposite direction of forward.
The word behind means at the back of something.
The word below means lower than something else in space.
The word beside means next to something.
A direction is a way to move or point.
The word forward means moving toward the front.
Directions show the way to a place.
The boy walked forward toward the bright light.
He saw a path that went forward and another that went backward.
He looked below and saw a blue fish swimming in the water.
He turned to look behind and saw his dog, waiting beside the path.
He felt a strong wind from behind and knew he must go forward.
He reached the end and found a box with a key inside.
He went forward along the path toward the trees.
He walked across the path and saw a house next to the water.
